summary: Equinor ASA furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing daily repurchases under its employee share-programme buy-back announced 4 February 2026, running 13 February 2026 to 15 January 2027. On 15 October 2026 the company bought 389,058 own shares on the Oslo Stock Exchange at a weighted average of NOK 429.2415, totaling NOK 166,999,840. Programme size is NOK 1,971,000,000 and up to 19,600,000 shares. Cumulative buy-backs reach 4,167,500 shares at a NOK 352.6927 average; treasury now holds 23,077,317 shares, 0.97% of capital. Watch remaining programme capacity and daily execution pace.
